Risk: High variance policy gradient impedes stable reinforcement learning training
Problem analysis: Reward-weighted gradient without baseline leads to noisy updates
Theoretical insight: Baseline that is independent of action reduces estimator variance without bias
Implementation mechanism: REINFORCE algorithm with baseline in stochastic policy networks
Validation evidence: Empirical faster convergence with baseline in policy gradient
Intervention: Use baseline subtraction in policy-gradient algorithms during RL training to reduce variance
